name: unity-ps5
notes: Engine-family base for Unity PS5 player titles (IL2CPP).

Layout: eboot.bin is the Unity player; the C# game code is Media/Modules/Il2cppUserAssemblies.prx, loaded with PS5Util.prx by sceKernelLoadStartModule; plugin prx under Media/Plugins (PSN, CommonDialog, SaveData, fmod, burst...). All are translated as companion modules: the app0 view must have Media/Modules and Media/Plugins as real directories (the companion walk does not follow directory symlinks).
Leave the dumper's ampr_emu.index out of app0; never exclude libSceAmpr (exclusion binds its NIDs to zero stubs).

NPS5_VQ_RESERVED_UNCOMMITTED: Unity's virtual-memory commit reads VirtualQuery isCommitted to choose mprotect vs allocate + MAP_FIXED map on its sceKernelReserveVirtualRange ranges (console semantics; opt-in until ASTRO/SAROS regression runs).
NPS5_UNRESOLVED_RET0: bring-up only. PSN.prx imports ~1,600 sce::Np::CppWebApi C++ entries the shipped libSceNpCppWebApi.prx does not export (online paths).
NPS5_VFS_DEVLOG: the Unity player writes its player log to /devlog/app/debug.log (dev-kit volume); mounted on <userdata>/devlog/app/debug.log for bring-up.

NPS5_KYTY_PROGRESS_VERDICT: Unity's gfx worker writes a descriptor every frame into a 16 KiB host page whose neighbour tracker page Kyty re-arms every frame (~250 faults/s at one address); without the switch the runtime's fault livelock guard (20,000 claimed faults, <50 ms apart) reads that as a livelock after ~80 s and ends the run in a SIGBUS report (PPSA28997 r13). Opt-in until ASTRO/SAROS regression runs.

NPS5_SAVEDATA_PREPARE_RW: the PS5 transactional save (Unity SaveData plugin) mounts its own save RDONLY (|CREATE2), creates a transaction resource and calls sceSaveDataPrepare to write; Prepare must open the mount for writing (it returned INTERNAL 0x809f000b and the game showed the save-error dialog). Opt-in until ASTRO/SAROS regression runs.
Gating rule (USER): game/engine-specific runtime changes are env-gated, default off, set here; ASTRO/SAROS stay byte-identical without this profile until a regression run clears a switch.

NPS5_PRX_ENTRY_ARGS: a PRX entry started by sceKernelLoadStartModule gets (argc, argv, NULL) and its result goes to *res (Il2cppUserAssemblies.prx jumped to a stale RDX). NPS5_UMTX_OP: _umtx_op WAIT/WAKE (PS5Util.prx events; off = unresolved import). NPS5_PTHREAD_ATTR_REAL: scePthreadAttrGet/Getstack/Getstackaddr report the thread's real stack (IL2CPP Boehm GC roots). NPS5_AVPLAYER_UNITY: sceAvPlayerGetStreamInfoEx, seeking JumpToTime, WARNING_ID LOOPING_BACK at a loop point (VideoPlayer).

NPS5_ACM_CONTEXT_OK: sceAcmContextCreate/Destroy/BatchStartBuffers/BatchWait succeed (no DSP output). FMOD's PS5 System::setOutput creates an ACM context and failed ERR_INTERNAL without it: no FMOD system, FMODUnity.RuntimeManager.Instance threw SystemNotInitializedException every frame (PPSA28997 r21-r24).
NPS5_SYSMODULE_ISLOADED_SCE: sceSysmoduleIsLoaded returns SCE_OK / 0x805A1001 (SDK) instead of 1/0. No effect seen on PPSA28997 (r22); left off.

NPS5_NET_SOCKOPT_MAP=1: sceNetSetsockopt maps SCE_NET options (SOL_SOCKET 0xffff: SO_NBIO 0x1200 -> fcntl O_NONBLOCK, SCE-only 0x1100-0x1108 accepted, unknown host options ignored) instead of passing them to host setsockopt, which fails on 0x1200 (FMOD Live Update socket setup). Set in env below (PPSA28997 c1/c4: FMOD banks load, title -> NEW GAME -> first level). Unity-profile only, so ASTRO/SAROS are unaffected.
